title: Mission + Vision
slide_intent: Separate what a company aims to do from what it hopes to become so readers can distinguish direction from aspiration.
strategic_value: Connecting customers and earning their preference can give T-Mobile teams a common basis for choices.
demonstration: A mission statement occupies the upper center; a ruled divider separates a vision with a large magenta #1 below.
practical_value: Compare a proposed message with the distinct mission and vision statements.

content_islands.name: Mission
content_islands.spec: Center the mission label over a large white statement on black.

content_islands.name: Vision
content_islands.spec: Place the vision below a thin rule, using magenta #1 beside two white lines.
